The four Lean declarations are only the actual finite low-rank structural/parity bridge. No theta presentation or desired inequality is inserted as a premise, and no all-uniformity/higher-density Lean completion is claimed.

The selected-incidence candidates derive universal sparsity and proper-count strictness, rather than assume them. The actual r-expansion geometry and literal graph/hypergraph ratio endpoints remain listed as pending.
